metadata.title: Aaloo Lai | Potatoes with Mustard Greens
metadata.description:
Mustard greens are in season now and I decided to make a very simple but delicious and healthy dish that features very commonly in our households. 

Potatoes with Mustard greens is a rustic combination and a classic one too.
